description: Additional data points needed to analyze, value, and plan for U.S. business-owning high-net-worth clients using corporate finance, tax, and portfolio analytics.

required.label: Future Value Target
required.description: The specific future dollar amount (such as expected sale proceeds or account value) to be discounted or projected in time value of money analyses.

required.label: Present Value Amount
required.description: The current dollar amount available or invested that will be grown to a future value under an assumed rate of return.

required.label: Discount / Return Rate
required.description: The annual rate used to discount future cash flows or grow present values when evaluating projects and planning scenarios.

required.label: Time Horizon (Years)
required.description: The number of years over which the cash flows or investments are projected or discounted.

required.label: Projected Cash Flow Schedule
required.description: A period-by-period schedule of expected business or project cash flows used for NPV and IRR analyses.

required.label: Initial Investment Amount
required.description: The upfront capital outlay or purchase price used as the initial cash flow in NPV and IRR calculations.

required.label: Market Value of Equity
required.description: The total market value of the owners' equity used in capital structure and WACC calculations.

required.label: Market Value of Debt
required.description: The total market value of interest-bearing debt obligations used in capital structure and WACC calculations.

required.label: Cost of Equity
required.description: The required rate of return on the business's equity used in WACC and valuation work.

required.label: Pre-Tax Cost of Debt
required.description: The average interest rate the business pays on its debt, used to determine the debt component of WACC.

required.label: Marginal Tax Rate
required.description: The client's marginal income tax rate used to convert pre-tax cost of debt to an after-tax rate in WACC.

required.label: Risk-Free Rate
required.description: The yield on a risk-free benchmark (such as U.S. Treasuries) used in CAPM and Sharpe ratio calculations.

required.label: Expected Market Return
required.description: The expected return on the overall market portfolio used in CAPM to estimate required return on equity.

required.label: Equity Beta
required.description: The measure of the business or portfolio's sensitivity to market movements used in the CAPM formula.

required.label: Current Assets
required.description: The total value of assets expected to be converted to cash within one year used to assess liquidity.

required.label: Current Liabilities
required.description: The total obligations due within one year used in computing the current ratio.

required.label: Total Liabilities
required.description: The total book value of all short- and long-term obligations used to assess leverage.

required.label: Total Equity
required.description: The total book value of shareholders' equity used in leverage and profitability ratios.

required.label: Net Income
required.description: The business's net earnings after all expenses and taxes, used in ROE and margin analysis.

required.label: Beginning Shareholders' Equity
required.description: The shareholders' equity balance at the start of the period used to compute average equity for ROE.

required.label: Ending Shareholders' Equity
required.description: The shareholders' equity balance at the end of the period used to compute average equity for ROE.

required.label: Net Sales
required.description: Total sales revenue after returns and allowances used to calculate net profit margin.

required.label: Above-the-Line Deductions
required.description: Total deductions that reduce gross income to arrive at adjusted gross income in the client's tax calculation.

required.label: Standard or Itemized Deductions
required.description: The total amount of standard or itemized deductions claimed when computing taxable income.

required.label: Qualified Business Income (QBI)
required.description: The amount of qualified business income from pass-through entities used to compute the QBI deduction.

required.label: Net Earnings from Self-Employment
required.description: The client's net earnings subject to self-employment tax for sole proprietorships and partnerships.

required.label: Social Security Wage Base
required.description: The annual Social Security wage base limit used to cap the portion of earnings subject to the full self-employment tax rate.

required.label: Net Investment Income
required.description: The client's total net investment income potentially subject to the Net Investment Income Tax.

required.label: Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI)
required.description: The client's MAGI used to determine exposure to the Net Investment Income Tax.

required.label: NIIT Threshold Amount
required.description: The applicable MAGI threshold for Net Investment Income Tax based on filing status.

required.label: Taxable Estate Value
required.description: The value of the taxable estate used to determine tentative federal estate tax.

required.label: Applicable Estate Tax Credit Amount
required.description: The unified credit amount available to offset the tentative federal estate tax.

required.label: Prior Year Retirement Account Balance
required.description: The total balance of relevant tax-deferred retirement accounts at the end of the prior year used for RMD calculations.

required.label: IRS Distribution Period Factor
required.description: The life expectancy factor from the IRS RMD table corresponding to the client's age and situation.

required.label: Portfolio Expected Return
required.description: The average or expected annual return of the client's investment portfolio used in risk-adjusted performance metrics.

required.label: Portfolio Return Series
required.description: A time series of periodic portfolio returns used to calculate volatility and risk-adjusted metrics.

required.label: Net Operating Income
required.description: The income generated from operations before interest and taxes used to assess debt service coverage.

required.label: Total Debt Service
required.description: The total required principal and interest payments on debt over a year used in DSCR analysis.

required.label: Total Sales
required.description: Total revenue from sales before deducting variable costs used in contribution margin analysis.

required.label: Total Variable Costs
required.description: Total costs that vary directly with sales volume used to determine contribution margin ratio.

optional.label: Estate Tax Rate Schedule Reference
optional.description: A reference to the specific federal estate tax rate schedule used for precise estate tax calculations.
optional.example_value: Current Federal Estate Tax Rate Table

optional.label: Client Tax Filing Status
optional.description: The client's income tax filing status which may affect thresholds and deduction limits in tax-related formulas.
